zh.title: 俄亥俄州未來論壇聚焦臺灣無人機產業 臺美將續建可信賴供應鏈
zh.summary: 俄亥俄州論壇聚焦臺灣無人機產業，臺美將持續合作打造可信賴供應鏈。
body: 美國俄亥俄州年度「未來論壇」（Future Forum）8日在東自由市（East Liberty）交通研發中心舉行，論壇以科技、基建與運輸製造為主題。臺灣專場聚焦半導體、無人機及輪胎科技，並探討自駕計程車、無人卡車與無人載具快遞貨運等交通科技發展。
臺灣政府重視無人機發展並推動國家隊；臺灣已有200多家廠商，今年前7個月出口15萬架輕型無人機，多數銷往東歐國家。臺灣工研院加入美國無人機產業協會「綠色無人機系統」計畫，成為美國以外唯一認證據點。
臺灣無人機產業已與美國業者及產業聯盟簽署多項合作備忘錄，並將持續攜手打造可信賴的供應鏈體系。

en.title: Ohio Future Forum spotlights Taiwan's drone industry and supply-chain ties
en.summary: Ohio's Future Forum featured Taiwan's drone sector; Taiwan and US partners will continue trusted supply-chain cooperation.
body: Ohio's annual Future Forum, focused on technology, infrastructure, and transport manufacturing, was held on the 8th at a transportation research center in East Liberty. The Taiwan session focused on semiconductors, drones, and tire technology, as well as developments including self-driving taxis, autonomous trucks, and uncrewed-vehicle delivery and freight.

Taiwan's government is promoting development of the drone industry and a national team, according to the report. Taiwan has more than 200 drone companies and exported 150,000 light drones in the first seven months of this year, most to Eastern European countries. Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute joined the US drone industry's Green UAS program and became its only certified site outside the United States.
Taiwan's drone industry has signed multiple memorandums of understanding with US companies and industry alliances. The parties are to continue working together to build a trusted supply chain.

zh.title: NASA Crew-12四名太空人結束237天任務 濺落太平洋
zh.summary: SpaceX龍飛船載四名太空人返抵地球；任務自2月升空，繞行逾百萬英里
body: 四名太空人於10月8日返回地球，在太空中停留237天後，搭乘SpaceX的乘龍號（Crew Dragon）太空艙，在降落傘帶動下濺落於加州洛杉磯外海的太平洋。報導指出，太空艙的減速傘於美東時間11時30分（格林威治標準時間15時30分）展開，隨即在11時34分（格林威治標準時間15時34分）濺落。
報導稱，龍飛船的返航歷程約27小時，此前於週三脫離軌道實驗室。太空船點燃發動機減速並脫離軌道，隨後進入地球大氣層，由隔熱盾保護組員度過重返大氣層的高溫。
回收船上的團隊，包括兩艘快艇，固定了這艘SpaceX龍飛船，並確認太空艙適合進行回收作業。快艇團隊完成工作後，回收船就位，將艙體連同艙內太空人吊上主甲板。
報導指出，太空艙載回NASA太空人Jessica Meir與Jack Hathaway、歐洲太空總署（ESA）太空人Sophie Adenot以及俄羅斯太空人Andrey Fedyaev，結束這場始於2月的任務，期間在國際太空站（ISS）進行數月科學研究。
NASA署長Jared Isaacman表示，四人在軌道生活與工作237天，飛行超過1億英里，推進了重要科學，並平安返家；NASA詹森太空中心低地球軌道計畫經理Dana Weigel則表示，歡迎四人回家。
報導稱，Crew-12於2月13日搭乘SpaceX獵鷹9號火箭，自佛羅裏達州卡納維爾角太空軍基地升空，龍飛船隔日與國際太空站對接。任務期間四人飛行超過1億英里，完成逾3,792圈繞地軌道；Meir擔任指令長，Hathaway為駕駛，Adenot與Fedyaev為任務專家。
報導並指出，這是Meir與Fedyaev的第二次太空飛行，Hathaway與Adenot則是首次；Meir曾在2019年至2020年間於國際太空站停留205天，並參與首次全女性太空漫步。

en.title: NASA Crew-12 astronauts return to Earth after 237 days in space
en.summary: Four astronauts splash down in the Pacific off Los Angeles in a SpaceX Crew Dragon; mission began in February
body: Four astronauts returned to Earth on 8 October after spending 237 days in space, their SpaceX Crew Dragon capsule descending beneath parachutes before splashing down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of Los Angeles in California, according to Aerospace Global News.

The report said the vehicle's drogue parachutes deployed at 11:30 EDT (15:30 GMT), followed shortly by the main chutes, and splashdown took place at 11:34 EDT (15:34 GMT). Dragon's return followed a journey of about 27 hours after it undocked from the orbiting laboratory on Wednesday, the report added.

The spacecraft fired its engines to slow down and leave orbit before plunging into Earth's atmosphere, where its heat shield protected the crew from the extreme temperatures of re-entry, according to the report. Teams aboard the recovery ship, including two fast boats, secured the SpaceX Dragon and ensured the spacecraft was safe for the recovery effort, after which the recovery ship hoisted Dragon onto the main deck with the astronauts inside.

The capsule brought home NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, European Space Agency (ESA) astronaut Sophie Adenot and Russian cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev, ending a mission that began in February and included months of scientific research aboard the International Space Station (ISS).

NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said the four spent 237 days living and working in orbit, travelled more than 100 million miles, advanced important science and returned safely home. Dana Weigel, manager of NASA's Low Earth Orbit Program at the agency's Johnson Space Center, said NASA's activities supporting the ISS enable the science, engineering and risk-reduction needed for future missions.

Crew-12 launched aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida on 13 February, and their Dragon spacecraft docked with the ISS the following day, the report said. During the 237-day mission, the four crew members travelled more than 100 million miles and completed more than 3,792 orbits around Earth, it added.

The report said Meir commanded the mission, with Hathaway serving as pilot and Adenot and Fedyaev as mission specialists. It was the second spaceflight for Meir and Fedyaev and the first for Hathaway and Adenot, it added.

image.subject: LATAM Airlines Brazil takes delivery of first Embraer E195-E2
image.sourceCaption: LATAM Airlines Brazil takes delivery of first Embraer E195-E2

zh.title: LATAM接收首架E195-E2 目標2027年巴西航點突破70個
zh.summary: LATAM巴西接收12架E195-E2首機；2026年11月至2027年3月投入營運
body: LATAM Airlines Brazil已接收12架巴西航空工業E195-E2（ICAO機型代碼E195）噴射機中的第一架，這12架預定於今（2026）年交付。這批交機是該公司把國內航網延伸至較小、過去未提供服務城市計畫的一環，也屬於該航空集團8月公佈的機隊更新計畫一部分。
這款飛機是巴西航空工業第二代E-Jets家族中機型最大者，預計在完成巴西民航局（ANAC）最終認證，並取得海關與客艙內裝批准後，於2026年11月至2027年3月之間投入營運。
LATAM Airlines Brazil執行長Jerome Cadier表示：「有了E2，我們將把需求強勁、具經濟潛力的新市場連結到我們的全球航網。」他並指出，引進這款巴西航空工業客機將使該公司「最快在2027年就超越在巴西服務70個機場的里程碑」。
報導指出，LATAM目前在巴西服務63個機場，6年前為44個。E195-E2的油耗較第一代E-Jets最多低30%，航程3,000海里，並配備第四代線傳飛控航電系統。
整體而言，LATAM訂購最多74架此型機，其中前12架預定於2026年底前交付，另有12架預計在2027年交付。初期將有14架部署於42條航線，包括8條新航線與4個全新目的地：Cabo Frio、Ji-Paraná、Macaé與Rondonópolis；LATAM目前正評估最多18個新目的地。
巴西航空工業執行長Francisco Gomes Neto表示，這款飛機將在公司的擴張計畫中扮演重要角色，「兼具效率、營運彈性與舒適性」；他說，「看到E195-E2協助連結新目的地、支持巴西航空運輸發展，令人感到欣慰」。
報導指出，LATAM在宣佈訂單約一年後完成認證程序，使用巴西航空工業的展示機Profit Hunter進行疏散示範、評估飛行與機組訓練。客艙配置136個環保皮革座椅、2-2排列因此沒有中間座位，最多20個為豪華經濟艙座位，其餘為經濟艙；LATAM Pass會員可使用免費WiFi，每個座位配備USB-C連接埠並可存取LATAM Play機上娛樂平臺。

en.title: LATAM takes delivery of first of 12 Embraer E195-E2 jets, targets Brazilian expansion
en.summary: LATAM Airlines Brazil receives first of 12 Embraer E195-E2s; service expected November 2026 to March 2027
body: LATAM Airlines Brazil has received the first of 12 Embraer E195-E2 (ICAO type code E195) jets scheduled for delivery this year. The delivery underpins the airline's plans to extend its domestic network to smaller and previously unserved cities, and forms part of the airline group's wider fleet renewal programme revealed in August.

The aircraft, the largest in Embraer's second-generation E-Jets family, is expected to enter service between November 2026 and March 2027, once it completes final certification with Brazil's Civil Aviation Agency (ANAC) and receives customs and cabin interior approvals.

"With the E2, we will connect new markets with strong demand and economic potential to our global network," said Jerome Cadier, CEO of LATAM Airlines Brazil. He added that the addition of the Embraer jet will enable the airline to "surpass the milestone of 70 airports served in Brazil as early as 2027."

LATAM currently serves 63 airports across Brazil, up from 44 airports six years ago, according to the report. The E195-E2 offers up to 30% lower fuel burn than first-generation E-Jets, a range of 3,000 nm and fourth-generation fly-by-wire avionics.

In total, LATAM has an order for up to 74 of the aircraft type, with the first 12 scheduled for delivery by the end of 2026 and 12 more expected in 2027. Initially, 14 of the aircraft will be deployed across 42 routes, including eight new routes and four brand-new destinations: Cabo Frio, Ji-Paraná, Macaé and Rondonópolis. LATAM is currently assessing up to 18 new destinations.

Francisco Gomes Neto, CEO of Embraer, said the aircraft will play an important role in the company's expansion plans, "offering a combination of efficiency, operational flexibility and comfort." It is "gratifying," he said, "to see the E195-E2 contributing to connecting new destinations and supporting the development of air transportation in Brazil."

The report said LATAM moved quickly to certify the E195-E2, completing the process roughly a year after announcing the order and using Embraer's demonstrator, the Profit Hunter, for evacuation demonstrations, evaluation flights and crew training. The cabin will have 136 eco-leather seats in a 2-2 configuration with no middle seat, up to 20 premium economy seats and the rest in economy; registered LATAM Pass members can access free WiFi, while every seat will feature a USB-C port and access to LATAM Play, the airline's in-flight entertainment platform.
